FITCHBURG RETIREMENT BOARD MEETING 
 
PUBLIC NOTICE 
  
To:     Joanna Bilotta, City Clerk  
Meeting Date/Time:  Fitchburg Retirement Board 
10:00 a.m., Tuesday, November 24, 2026  
Location:    Fitchburg City Hall 
      North Meeting Room, Third Floor  
       718 Main Street  
       Fitchburg, MA  01420  
 
AGENDA  
   
1. Meeting Convenes – Pledge of Allegiance  
2. Public Comment – Members of the public have the opportunity to address the Retirement Board 
3. Approval of Payroll Warrant, Cash Disbursements Warrant, and Refunds/Transfers/Rollovers Warrant 
4. Review and Accept Cash Books and Bank Statements Reconciliations 
5. Approval of Meeting Minutes  
6. Review and Approval of Retirement Applications  
7. Acknowledge Deaths of Members and Beneficiaries   
8. Approval of New Members and Group Classification Changes 
9. Executive Session – Purpose 7 of the Open Meeting Law: “To Comply with, or act under the authority of, any 
general…law”, that law being Excemption (c) of the Public Records Law (G.L. c. 4, s. 7(26)(c)). 
a) Review of Medical Panel Reports – Michael Smith 
10. Annual Performance Evaluations 
11. Review and Accept CY27 Meeting Schedule 
12. Director’s Communications 
13. Legislative/Legal updates 
14. PRIT Fund Performance updates 
15. New Business 
 
The Board reserves the right to consider items on the agenda out of order. Items listed on the Agenda are those 
reasonably anticipated by the Board Chairperson to be discussed at the meeting at least forty-eight hours in advance. 
Not all items listed may in fact be discussed and other items not listed may also be brought up for discussion to the 
extent permitted by law. Items identified for discussion in Executive Session may be conducted in open session, in 
addition to or in lieu of discussion in Executive Session.
